name: Team Cymru Malware Hash Registry (DNS zone hash.cymru.com)
tier_rationale: Established security company and community steward with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted); P176 final condition 4: 'Registry provider team_cymru: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Aggregated antivirus detection percentage per hash with a last-seen date; known false positives exist (the empty-file MD5 answers 91%).

mhr.title: Malware Hash Registry: TXT {md5|sha1}.hash.cymru.com through the core DoH resolver ('<last_seen_epoch> <AV detection %>'; NXDOMAIN = not in MHR)

terms.quote: MHR is free for non-commercial use. (team-cymru.com, verified 2026-11-26) - P176 cond 2 (binding council text): terms 'noncommercial'; off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (a commercial MHR agreement or a licence_allow entry recorded by legal); in the research profile only with a recorded legal basis and the licence banner.

mhr.notes: Research C0412 (verified live 2026-11-26 through dns.google and cloudflare-dns.com). DNS only, never raw HTTP: hosts [] because the core DoH resolvers carry the query (they and Team Cymru's authoritative servers see the hash; the disclosure ledger lists the resolver hosts). SHA-256 is unsupported (64-character label > 63; Google DoH answers HTTP 400). DoH answers are cached by the core resolver, never charged to quotas.
mhr.licensed_alternative: A commercial MHR agreement with Team Cymru or a licence_allow entry recorded by legal for team_cymru.mhr (P176 cond 2).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-1 (P176, module malware_hash/cymru_mhr). Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN DNS service (team_cymru_asn) runs over core_doh with its own terms and is not part of this provider.
